verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Our blessing cup is a communion
with the blood of Christ

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And the bread we break,
it is a sharing in the body of the Lord

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
How can we make a return,
for all the goodness God has shown

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We will take the cup of life
And call upon God's name

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Precious indeed in Your sight,
The life and death of those You love

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
We are Your servants,
for You have set us free

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Gracious and merciful God
We give thanks and bless Your name

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
With all Your people
praise and glory to Your name

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
For You have heard my voice
For You have heard my pleading

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
Though death surrounded me
You heard and answered me
